item.title: Optimized Bragg Grating Liquid Crystal Solar Sail
item.description: arXiv:2610.28942v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We have designed a thin 3-layer sun-facing diffractive Bragg reflector comprised of a chiral polymeric liquid crystal film. Using Rigorous Coupled-Wave Analysis (RCWA), the stack was optimized to maximize the transverse radiation pressure force across the wavelength band 0.47 - 1.67 micrometers. item.title: Intermolecular decoupling of C<sub>60</sub> suppresses interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 13 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02030-x Interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells is mitigated through a vapour-phase molecular passivation method using trialkylamines, disrupting C60 packing. This approach results in a power conversion efficiency of up to 27.2% while maintaining stability.
